scripts.text:
[Hotel Employee]
Welcome to
the Royal Dragon,
where you can find the
finest accomodations
and the best service.
scripts.translation:
[酒店員工]
歡迎光臨皇家龍酒店，這裡為您提供一流的住宿和最優質的服務。

scripts.text: Save Point
scripts.translation: 儲存復活點

scripts.text: Rest - 5,000 zeny
scripts.translation: 休息 - 5,000 Zeny

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Hotel Employee]
Thank you, your
Respawn Point has
been saved here in
the Royal Dragon.
scripts.translation:
[酒店員工]
謝謝，您的復活點已保存於皇家龍酒店。

scripts.text:
[Hotel Employee]
I'm sorry, but
you need 5,000 zeny
in order to check in.
scripts.translation:
[酒店員工]
很抱歉，入住需要5,000 Zeny。

scripts.text:
[Hotel Employee]
Thank you~
I hope you enjoy
your stay in the
Royal Dragon.
scripts.translation:
[酒店員工]
謝謝~
祝您在皇家龍酒店住得愉快。

scripts.text:
[Hotel Employee]
Thank you and
have a nice day.
scripts.translation:
[酒店員工]
謝謝，祝您今天愉快。

scripts.text:
[Inn Master]
Good day~
Welcome to the
most comfortable
inn here in Veins~
scripts.translation:
[旅店主人]
您好~歡迎光臨伯仁斯最舒適的旅店~

scripts.text: Save
scripts.translation: 儲存

scripts.text: Take a Rest -> 5000 zeny
scripts.translation: 休息 -> 5000 Zeny

scripts.text: Quit
scripts.translation: 退出

scripts.text:
[Inn Master]
Your Respawn Point
has been saved in Veins.
Enjoy your stay in town~
scripts.translation:
[旅店主人]
您的復活點已保存於伯仁斯。
祝您在城裡度過愉快的時光~

scripts.text:
[Inn Master]
I'm sorry, but I don't
think you have enough
money to check in. The
service charge is 5,000 zeny.
scripts.translation:
[旅店主人]
很抱歉，您的錢好像不夠入住，費用是5,000 Zeny。

scripts.text:
[Inn Master]
Enjoy your stay~
scripts.translation:
[旅店主人]
祝您住得愉快~

scripts.text:
[Inn Master]
Please come again.
scripts.translation:
[旅店主人]
請再次光臨。

scripts.text:
[Hotel Keeper]
Welcome to the beautiful Brasilis Hotel.
scripts.translation:
[酒店老闆]
歡迎光臨美麗的巴西酒店。

scripts.text: Save
scripts.translation: 儲存

scripts.text: Rest -5000 zeny
scripts.translation: 休息 - 5000 Zeny

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Hotel Keeper]
Do you want to save here at the Brasilis Hotel?
scripts.translation:
[酒店老闆]
要在巴西酒店儲存復活點嗎？

scripts.text: No thank you.
scripts.translation: 不用了，謝謝

scripts.text: Absolutely.
scripts.translation: 當然要

scripts.text:
[Hotel Keeper]
Ok then, enjoy your stay.
scripts.translation:
[酒店老闆]
好，祝您住得愉快。

scripts.text:
[Hotel Keeper]
Your respawn has been saved here at the hotel. I hope that you enjoy your stay here in Brasilis.
scripts.translation:
[酒店老闆]
您的復活點已保存於酒店。
祝您在巴西度過愉快的時光。

scripts.text:
[Hotel Keeper]
I will show you a great room.
scripts.translation:
[酒店老闆]
我帶您去一間很不錯的客房。

scripts.text:
[Hotel Keeper]
I'm sorry, but the service charge is 5,000 zeny per night.
scripts.translation:
[酒店老闆]
很抱歉，每晚的服務費是5,000 Zeny。

scripts.text:
[Hotel Employee]
Good day, welcome to the
Einbroch Hotel. The staff is
always striving to accommodate
our guests with the highest
standards in cleanliness,
service and convenience~
scripts.translation:
[酒店員工]
您好，歡迎光臨艾音布羅克酒店。
我們始終致力於提供最高標準的清潔、服務與便利，讓客人住得舒心~

scripts.text:
[Hotel Employee]
Are you looking
for Mr. Defru Ark?
Oh right, he did mention
waiting for some package
from the Airport. Now let
me pull up that information...
scripts.translation:
[酒店員工]
您在找德弗魯·阿克先生嗎？
對了，他說過正在等機場送來的包裹。
讓我查一下...

scripts.text:
[Hotel Employee]
Ah, here we are.
Mr. Defru Ark is
staying in Room 201.
scripts.translation:
[酒店員工]
找到了，德弗魯·阿克先生住在201號房。

scripts.text: Save
scripts.translation: 儲存

scripts.text: Take Rest - 5,000 zeny
scripts.translation: 休息 - 5,000 Zeny

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Hotel Employee]
Your Respawn Point
has been saved here
in the Einbroch Hotel.
Thank you, and please
come again.
scripts.translation:
[酒店員工]
您的復活點已保存於艾音布羅克酒店。
謝謝，歡迎再次光臨。

scripts.text:
[Hotel Employee]
Thank you.
Please enjoy
your rest~
scripts.translation:
[酒店員工]
謝謝。
祝您休息愉快~

scripts.text:
[Hotel Employee]
I'm sorry, but the
accommodation fee is
5,000 zeny. Next time,
please make sure that you
bring enough zeny, okay?
scripts.translation:
[酒店員工]
很抱歉，住宿費是5,000 Zeny。
下次請確保攜帶足夠的Zeny，好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Hotel Employee]
Thank you and
please come again~
scripts.translation:
[酒店員工]
謝謝，歡迎再次光臨~

scripts.text:
[Hotel Employee]
Have a good day.
scripts.translation:
[酒店員工]
祝您有美好的一天。
